scripts.build: vite build web && bun scripts/check-webview-compat.ts web/dist
scripts.deploy:prod: bun scripts/preflight.ts && export FRAME_IMAGE_TAG=$(nix eval --raw ../..#garage-frame-image.imageTag) && bun scripts/load-image.ts $FRAME_IMAGE_TAG && alchemy deploy --stage prod --yes && bun scripts/verify-deploy.ts $FRAME_IMAGE_TAG
scripts.lint: oxlint --type-aware --config ../../oxlint.config.mjs src/ test/ web/src/ web/test/ scripts/ alchemy.run.ts
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --type-aware --config ../../oxlint.config.mjs --fix src/ test/ web/src/ web/test/ scripts/ alchemy.run.ts
scripts.format: oxfmt --config ../../oxfmt.config.mjs --check src/ test/ web/src/ web/test/ scripts/ alchemy.run.ts package.json tsconfig.json web/vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts
